import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.Arrays;

import javax.imageio.ImageIO;

import net.coobird.thumbnailator.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.geometry.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.makers.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.name.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.configurations.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.io.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.util.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.util.exif.*;

public final class ApiTest {
    private ApiTest() {}

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            String grid_png = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_A1/experiments/external/thumbnailator/source/src/test/resources/Thumbnailator/grid.png";
    String grid_jpeg = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_A1/experiments/external/thumbnailator/source/src/test/resources/Thumbnailator/grid.jpg";
    String exif_jpeg = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_A1/experiments/external/thumbnailator/source/src/test/resources/Exif/original.jpg";
    String output_dir = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_A1/experiments/external/thumbnailator/.aideal_exec/A1/output";

    // pre-loaded typed inputs (comprehension.execute.preamble)
    BufferedImage sourceImage = new BufferedImage(32, 24, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB);
    Graphics2D graphics = sourceImage.createGraphics();
    graphics.setColor(Color.BLUE);
    graphics.fillRect(0, 0, 32, 24);
    graphics.setColor(Color.YELLOW);
    graphics.fillRect(8, 6, 16, 12);
    graphics.dispose();
    BufferedImage destinationImage = new BufferedImage(16, 12, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB);
    ByteArrayOutputStream imageBytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
    Path outputPath = Paths.get(output_dir, "thumbnail.png");
    Files.createDirectories(outputPath.getParent());

            // TODO API_TEST_START
            net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter param = null;
            try {
                Class<?> resizerClass = Class.forName("net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.Resizer");
                Object dummyResizer = java.lang.reflect.Proxy.newProxyInstance(
                    resizerClass.getClassLoader(),
                    new Class<?>[] { resizerClass },
                    (proxy, method, methodArgs) -> null
                );

                for (java.lang.reflect.Constructor<?> c : net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter.class.getConstructors()) {
                    Object[] args = new Object[c.getParameterCount()];
                    Class<?>[] types = c.getParameterTypes();
                    int stringCount = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < types.length; i++) {
                        if (types[i] == java.awt.Dimension.class) args[i] = new java.awt.Dimension(100, 100);
                        else if (types[i] == boolean.class) args[i] = true;
                        else if (types[i] == int.class) args[i] = java.awt.image.BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB;
                        else if (types[i] == float.class) args[i] = 1.0f;
                        else if (types[i] == double.class) args[i] = 1.0;
                        else if (types[i] == String.class) {
                            args[i] = (stringCount == 0) ? "png" : null;
                            stringCount++;
                        }
                        else if (types[i] == java.util.List.class) args[i] = java.util.Collections.emptyList();
                        else if (types[i] == resizerClass) args[i] = dummyResizer;
                        else args[i] = null;
                    }
                    try {
                        param = (net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter) c.newInstance(args);
                        if (param != null) break;
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        // ignore and try next constructor
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Failed to set up ThumbnailParameter dependencies", e);
            }

            if (param == null) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Could not instantiate ThumbnailParameter");
            }

            java.io.File sourceFile = new java.io.File(grid_png);
            java.io.File destFile = outputPath.toFile();

            net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.FileThumbnailTask task = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.FileThumbnailTask(param, sourceFile, destFile);

            java.awt.image.BufferedImage img = task.read();
            assert img != null : "Read image should not be null";
            assert img.getWidth() > 0 && img.getHeight() > 0 : "Image dimensions should be positive";

            task.write(img);

            assert destFile.exists() : "Destination file should exist";
            assert destFile.length() > 0 : "Destination file should not be empty";
            assert task.getSource().equals(sourceFile) : "Source file should match the provided input";
            assert task.getDestination().equals(destFile) : "Destination file should match the provided output";
            assert task.getParam() == param : "Parameter should match the provided instance";

            System.out.println("__CHECK__ FileThumbnailTask " + destFile.length());
            // TODO API_TEST_END
            System.out.println("__DONE__");
        } catch (Throwable exc) {
            System.err.println("__RUN_ERR__ " + exc.getClass().getSimpleName()
                    + ": " + exc.getMessage());
            exc.printStackTrace(System.err);
            System.exit(1);
        }
    }
}
